tools.name: epr.us
tools.description: Calculate packaging kilograms by official OR, CO or CA category, or MD, MN or WA 2025 interim category. Automatic classification covers qualifying corrugated boxes, paperboard cartons, kraft fill and shipping mailers, PE mailers and bubble wrap, resin-marked PET and HDPE bottles or jars, qualifying HDPE pails in CA, PP tubs, glass bottles and jars outside deposit programs, aluminum or steel cans, molded pulp and EPS cushioning. Coverage and required BOM facts vary by state. Other components need a verified categoryByState or return needs_review with candidate categories. Charges $0.50 per state CSV produced. $0.5 per report.

period.description: Inclusive shipment dates for one reporting period.

form.description: Use consumer_box for retail or direct-to-consumer boxes, shipping_mailer for an envelope or bag used as product packaging, envelope for stationery, packing_paper for loose fill sheets, cushioning for formed protective inserts or foam blocks, and tub for a container with a mouth similar in size to its base. A can is a closed non-aerosol, non-pressurized container. Use pallet for a rigid transport pallet, copy_paper for copier stock, and construction_paper for paper used in building construction. Use other only for a known form outside this list.

printed.description: For stationery envelopes, whether supplied printed.

containerGlass.description: Whether a bottle or jar is made of container glass.

color.description: Use light_blue_or_green for transparent light blue or green PET. Natural milky HDPE is clear_natural. Use white for white pigment or white foam.

consumerUse.description: Personal or commercial use by an end consumer, or non_consumer for packaging that stays in the supply chain.

containsPlastic.description: For California, whether the component includes reportable plastic. Supply the dominant material in material.

smallFormat.description: Small-format status under the state's rules after any applicable sorting exceptions. Usually at least two dimensions are 2 inches or less.

dimensionsInches.description: Length, width and height in inches. For circular items, use the diameter for length and width. Measure flexible items laid flat.

preferredSizeSorting.description: Whether the item has an APR Preferred size-sorting assessment. Supply for at-threshold dimensions where the state applies this exception.

fiberSource.description: Required for paper and fiber classification. Use wood for wood pulp, non_wood for a named non-wood plant fiber, or recycled for recycled paper fiber. Report algae and fungi in material instead.

type.description: Name of the plant fiber, such as bagasse or bamboo.

bleached.description: Whether the paperboard substrate is bleached.

coating.description: Coating or laminate on the substrate. Use none for uncoated and unlaminated substrates, recycle_compatible for a recycling-compatible water-soluble coating, or other_barrier for wax, silicone, foil or another incompatible coating or layer.

coatingSides.description: Which sides of the paperboard have a coating or lamination.

contents.description: Contents of covered packaging. Hazardous means the product meets the reporting definition for hazard labeling. Raw_meat means direct contact with raw meat. Use other for verified ordinary contents or packaging that does not contain a product.

containsProduct.description: Whether the packaging is used to contain a packaged product.

resinCode.description: Resin identification code displayed on the item. Use null if there is no mark and omit if its presence is unknown.

expanded.description: Whether polystyrene is expanded or foamed.

monoMaterial.description: For film, whether it contains only the stated resin and has no layers of other materials.

bagFormat.description: Whether a flexible or film item is a bag. Omit when unknown.

recyclingCompatible.description: Whether film or squeeze-tube layers meet the applicable state recycling criteria. Oregon PE film must meet APR PE-CG-01 and have no incompatible layers, coatings, resins or additives. Oregon non-consumer pallet wrap must have no barrier layers or non-PE resins.

compostability.description: Specify the applicable certification, designed for uncertified compostable plastic, or none when neither applies.

markedCompostable.description: Whether the plastic item is marked for compostability under the California reporting guidance.

treated.description: Whether wood is treated or painted.

pressurizedCylinderQualified.description: For Oregon cylinders, confirm the applicable DOT/UN specification or puncture-only design for non-refillable items, or an approved specification and water capacity of at most 109 L for refillable items. Exemptions are reported separately.

newsprint.description: Whether the substrate is newsprint under the applicable state's definition. For Maryland use Environment Article § 9-1707.

lowCirculationNewsMagazine.description: Whether a magazine has circulation below 95,000 and includes qualifying primary-source news or current-events content under the applicable state's definition.

waFilmCompostable.description: For Washington film in direct contact with raw meat, confirm whether it satisfies RCW 70A.208.020(7), including the applicable labeling requirements of chapter 70A.455 RCW.

beverageDepositByState.description: For a potentially deposit-eligible component, specify whether this component is covered by the state's beverage container deposit program in the report period. False means confirmed out of that program.

otherExemptionByState.description: After checking the state's covered-material guidance for this component and the supplied units, specify whether another exemption applies. tools.name: pfas.report
tools.description: Assess Minnesota PFAS reporting and Maine CUU notifications. Prepare PRISM or MELS entries, determine MDA registration and licensing statements and deadlines, and flag evidence gaps. Charges apply to required, not required, and not yet required determinations. Up to 500 product-state pairs. $0.25 per product-state pair.

asOf.description: Date on which to assess the reporting obligation under the cited rules.

hts.description: 6-, 8-, or 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule code with optional dots or spaces. UPC, HTS and GPC brick have equal priority in Minnesota. Maine uses this code when maineNotification.hts is omitted and requires ten digits for a CUU match.

gpcBrick.description: Eight-digit Global Product Classification brick assigned to the finished product. Maine uses this code when maineNotification.gpcBrick is omitted.

nonharmonizedCode.description: A nonharmonized numeric code other than SKU, such as a part number, assigned to the finished product.

labelCode.description: Other numeric code used on a label, listing, invoice or receipt. Provide its name for the PRISM Other Code Type Name field.

category.description: Use "Food packaging" or "Class B firefighting foam" for Minnesota products regulated under Minn. Stat. § 325F.075 or § 325F.072, respectively.

statesSold.description: Supported markets to assess. Include MN for planned market entry and provide firstMinnesotaSaleDate for MPCA reporting.

firstMinnesotaSaleDate.description: Earliest actual or planned date of sale, offer for sale, or distribution in or into Minnesota. Use the first market date for the product, not a production or shipment date for the current batch.

minnesotaReportedDescription.description: Supply the exact Product Model description from the filed MPCA report that covers this product. Omit it for any unreported product, including a new product from a manufacturer that already reports other products.

minnesotaReplacementFor.description: Supply only for a replacement part made by the same manufacturer and already covered by the original product report, with matching form, PFAS composition, concentration range, and function. Assess any separately reportable replacement-part packaging with the original product.

reportedProductDescription.description: Product Model in the original product's filed PRISM report.

reportedComponentName.description: Component in the filed report that covers this replacement part.

minnesotaUpdates.description: Outstanding significant changes or new product information for a filed MPCA product. Omit or pass an empty list when no update is outstanding. Each affected calendar year has one February 1 deadline in the following year.

minnesotaWaiver.description: Annual waiver decision or request for a specific outstanding MPCA report. Supply the applicable reporting due date before any waiver adjustment. For a partial approval, list the requirements waived by MPCA.

exemptions.description: State-specific screening result. Select federal preemption only where federal law preempts state regulation of PFAS presence. Select full_reporting_waiver for an approved waiver covering all waivable fields in that state.

MN.description: Verified reporting exemption under Minn. Stat. § 116.943 subds. 3 or 8(a) or Minn. R. 7026.0090. Classified information applies when all otherwise reportable information is classified and provided to a federal agency. Use review for uncertain or partial exemptions or third-party reporting.

ME.description: Verified exemption or waiver under 38 M.R.S. § 1614(3)–(4). For full_reporting_waiver, the DEP must have waived all waivable notification fields. Report the manufacturer, responsible official, applicable CUU and public information location under Chapter 90 § 3(A)(2). Exempt packaging excludes packaging sold as the manufacturer's product and fluorinated or intentionally added PFAS containers for products covered by § 1614(5)(B), (B-1), (D) or (E). The veterinary exemption excludes EPA-approved aerial or land application. Select federal agency standards, motor vehicle or watercraft only for qualifying products and exclude textile articles and refrigerants. Use review for uncertain or partial exemptions.

minnesotaAgency.description: Select MDA for products regulated under Minn. Stat. ch. 18B or 18C and specify kind for each component. Defaults to MPCA.

minnesotaMdaCategories.description: Select MDA product categories from the enum. For example, use fertilizer_pesticide_combination for weed and feed. Common aliases are accepted. If omitted, category must match an enum value or alias. Unrecognized categories need review.

minnesotaMdaFilingTypes.description: Select the filing type for each applicable MDA registration or license. An explicit type takes precedence. Otherwise, a pesticide renewal schedule implies renewal for the pesticide registration. With no renewal evidence for the filing, firstMinnesotaSaleDate implies an initial filing and sets the deadline to have approval in place. Obtain any required license before beginning licensed activity.

minnesotaPesticideRegistration.description: Filing schedule for a pesticide renewal under § 18B.26 subd. 7. A filing date outside the reporting year needs review. Without a schedule, a confirmed renewal uses the preceding December 31 after the initial 2026 reporting cycle.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year in which to submit the pesticide renewal statement and any ingredient report.

registrationDueDate.description: Scheduled renewal filing date within the reporting year. Defaults to December 31 of that year.

minnesotaExtensionApproved.description: For a decided MPCA extension request for the 2026 initial report, set true for approval or false for denial. Omit for the standard deadline when no request was denied or approved.

extensionDenialNoticeDate.description: Date of the MPCA denial notice for the 2026 initial report extension request. A denial needs this date to determine the reporting deadline.

maineUse.description: Match the actual PFAS use to Maine Chapter 90 § 9(B). Use other if neither designation applies, or pending for a proposed designation.

hts.description: Harmonized Tariff Schedule code with optional dots or spaces. A Maine CUU match requires ten digits.

publicInformationLocation.description: Directions to the publicly available substantially equivalent information. Required under Chapter 90 § 3(A)(2)(b) when using a DEP waiver.

totalOrganicFluorineWeightPercent.description: Total organic fluorine measured by a commercially available analytical method when individual amounts cannot reasonably be obtained.

totalWeightGrams.description: Fallback when individual amounts and TOF cannot reasonably be obtained.

name.description: Reportable component or homogeneous material. Include integral packaging where applicable.

kind.description: Classify each component for Minnesota MDA products. Formulation means active or inert ingredients of the registered formulation. Packaging and other components route to MPCA.

status.description: An intentionally added PFAS is present in the finished component.

substanceName.description: Chemical name. For Maine, supply the IUPAC name when no CAS RN exists.

casRn.description: CAS RN when known. For an unidentified Minnesota PFAS, leave blank and select the PRISM unknown chemical option in prism.name.

concentration.description: Weight concentration in the declared component or in the homogeneous product. Ranges include both endpoints.

melsRange.description: DEP-approved range verified by the caller in MELS.

prism.description: Values verified in the current PRISM reference. For confirmed presence with unknown identity, use "PFAS Present but unknown at this time" as name.

otherIdentifier.description: Verified alternative chemical identifying number for a chemical with no CAS RN. Confirm with MPCA before using Other.

totalOrganicFluorineWeightPercent.description: Analytically measured total organic fluorine as weight percent of this homogeneous component. Select TOF as name and use only when individual amounts cannot be obtained through due diligence.

enum: Functional group(s) other than alkyls present

components.description: List each reportable component. For Minnesota, group components only when they share PFAS composition, concentration bands, and function, and differ only superficially.

tools.name: demurrage.audit
tools.description: Audit up to 100 U.S. demurrage or detention invoices against 46 CFR Part 541 (2026-11-20), recalculate charges and draft disputes. $0.5 per invoice.

ratesCents.description: Daily rates applied to the billed dates, in USD cents.

disputeInstructions.description: Dispute method shown on the invoice. Include the public website address or the destination of any QR code or digital watermark.

documentText.description: Text from the invoice and its attachments. Labeled dates in this text are hints for review. Enter structured dates in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

notes.description: Additional free-text notes about the invoice.

invoice.description: One invoice for one container and charge type. Extract required information from all sections and attachments before omitting an absent field.

structuredFieldsComplete.description: Set to true after confirming that the structured fields capture all relevant information from the invoice, its attachments, shipment records, and the applicable tariff. Without this confirmation, any non-empty free text requires review, including invoice identifiers, names, text fields, and evidence references.

events.description: Import demurrage runs from discharge or availability to gate-out. Import detention defaults to gate-out through empty return. Export demurrage starts at full gate-in and uses the tariff's exportDemurrage rules. Export detention defaults to empty pickup through full gate-in.

earliestReturn.description: Published earliest receipt date (ERD) for the export booking, from an independent record. Actual gate-in may precede it.

erdChanges.description: Published terminal ERD changes for this export detention shipment, in announcement order. For a same-day pickup or return, include the change only if announced while the shipper held the container. Use an empty array if records confirm no change.

announcedOn.description: Facility-local date the terminal publicly announced the change.

fullGateIn.description: Delivery of the full export container to the terminal.

loadedOnOriginalVessel.description: Whether loading records confirm the container loaded on the originally scheduled vessel and voyage. Without this fact, a documented roll indicates a missed original voyage. Departure dates alone do not identify the voyage.

cargoCutoff.description: Last date for full gate-in on the originally booked export voyage.

scheduledSailDate.description: Scheduled departure date of the originally booked vessel.

actualSailDate.description: Actual departure date of the vessel carrying this container.

rolls.description: Documented, non-overlapping periods attributable to an export vessel roll. Start and end dates are inclusive.

resolutionDate.description: Date the customer resolved the cause. Null means the cause was still unresolved at the end of the roll period.

newScheduledSailDate.description: Scheduled departure of the replacement vessel booked on startDate. Supply each replacement schedule when the tariff uses a scheduled sailing cutoff.

lateDocumentation.description: Documented periods when the shipper's late paperwork delayed an export container. Start and end dates are inclusive.

blockedDays.description: Days of verified full-day inability to move this container for this charge, including lack of any authorized alternate facility or appointment.

reference.description: Applicable tariff, contract or terminal schedule reference.

freeTimeStartsAfter.description: Tariff milestone for starting free time. gate_in uses events.fullGateIn and empty_pickup uses events.emptyPickup. If omitted for import demurrage, compare discharge and availability when both are recorded. Other charges use their default milestones.

countBlockedFreeDays.description: Whether verified blocked days count toward free time. Defaults to true for calendar-day free time and false for business-day free time.

countBlockedChargeDays.description: Whether verified blocked days count after free time under the tariff. Defaults to true for calendar-day charges and false for business-day charges.

includeStartDay.description: True to begin counting on the milestone date, false to begin the following day.

includeEndDay.description: Whether the day the charge period ends can be charged.

exportDemurrage.description: Export demurrage rules transcribed from the supplied tariff for the circumstances of this shipment.

chargeableCauses.description: Complete list of causes the tariff permits after free time. An empty array means none apply. Omit if the tariff is unclear. Days with conflicting chargeable causes require review.

requiresOriginalVessel.description: Whether early receipt requires loading on the originally scheduled vessel and voyage. Set to false if the tariff permits the charge regardless of voyage.

oneOf.description: Charge dates before the published ERD when full gate-in preceded that ERD and the original-vessel condition is met.

maxDaysAfterResolution.description: Calendar days chargeable after the shipper resolves the cause. Omit for an uncapped rule.

oneOf.description: Charge days attributable to a documented customer-caused roll. With a scheduled sailing cutoff, this can include days before the roll, after free time, on the affected booking.
Charge dates attributable to the shipper's late documentation.

endsAt.description: Tariff milestone ending export demurrage. Supply when recording a scheduled or actual departure date. Without either date, the default is vessel load.

extendFreeTimeOnErdChange.description: Whether the tariff adds working days from the previous ERD through the day before the new ERD for a postponement announced while the shipper holds the container within free time.

weekend.description: ISO weekday numbers excluded in business-day mode.

usHolidays.description: Include national or state public holidays in business-day mode. Dataset covers 2020–2035.

holidays.description: Additional holidays excluded in business-day mode.

evidence.description: Independent records for checking stated invoice details. Use the same names, reference and dispute details where they match. Certification booleans describe whether the certified facts are true.

disputeInstructions.description: Dispute method shown on the invoice. Include the public website address or the destination of any QR code or digital watermark.

liableParty.description: Use the same legal entity names as on the invoice when they match.

reference.description: Independent evidence identifying the sole party liable for this charge.

basis.description: Liability basis documented by the independent evidence.

upstreamInvoiceDate.description: Issue date of the invoice received by the NVOCC.

lastIncurredDate.description: Independently documented last date this charge was incurred.

agreedResolutionDays.description: A longer resolution period agreed by both parties.

anyOf.description: Workbook with sheets named G702 and G703. In G702 use columns A–C for line number, amount, and optional Excel percentage rate. Include lines 1–9 and use 5 for total retainage. Include 5a and/or 5b for fixed retainage. Use the reported amounts on lines 5a and 5b or, when those amounts are blank, the total of G703 column I. A rate without either source requires review of the eligible base. In G703 use a single header row for columns A–I including percent complete, followed by SOV items. Missing financial columns and unrecognized headers require review.

retainageChange.description: New retainage rates for an agreed change or release, in percentage points. Use 0 for each released category. Fixed rates must match these values. For variable retainage these rates set the minimum amount on each item.

changeOrders.description: All approved changes through the current period. Omitting this list carries forward the prior approved SOV and net change when available.

amount.description: Total approved amount, including signed deductions.

reflectedInPrevious.description: With a prior application, set true for orders already included in its approved SOV and false for new orders. An unknown period requires review.

tools.name: otapayout.reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile Airbnb Earnings, Booking.com Reconciliation API v1, and Vrbo payout CSVs with bank deposits. Confirm only completed bank credits from a documented OTA payer with an exact transfer reference and agreeing currency, amount, and date. Maximum 100 distinct reservations per call. $0.3 per 100 reservations.

counterparty.description: Bank-reported sender of an incoming credit.

direction.description: Recognizes standard credit/debit codes and additional incomingValues. Negative amounts are debits. Unknown codes and negative credits require review.

status.description: Omit only for exports containing booked transactions exclusively.

ignored.description: List any other columns whose values do not affect the reconciliation.
